_evidence: 0x00411017 continues only when byte 0x007c2ea9 == 0x80 (cmp/jne), then 0x43b974 scans the 22 car records at 0x0066fef0 (stride 0x41c) for the first whose byte +0x7c (0x0066ff6c, and 0x3f) equals the teammate number; a hit with +0x7a bit 7 clear (0x0066ff6a) returns CF=1 and ebx = that record, whose byte +0xfe bit 2 (0x0066ffee) selects eax 2 or 0. Car numbers 0..22 give a hit in about 60% of the cases (and misses), the flag bytes vary fully.
